scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,white "npm run dev -w @ghost/api" "npm run dev -w @ghost/web"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,white "npm run start -w @ghost/api" "npm run start -w @ghost/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ghost/domain && npm run build -w @ghost/api && npm run build -w @ghost/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ghost/domain && npm run test -w @ghost/api
scripts.check:launch: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:budget && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ghost/domain && npm run typecheck -w @ghost/api && npm run typecheck -w @ghost/web
